issues.description: Element: Rideable.messageOnRide. The problem statement (UML and text) and the template Main expect a no-argument method messageOnRide() that returns a String and is called as r.messageOnRide(). In the solution, Rideable.messageOnRide is declared with a single parameter (String equipment) and Pig/Seal implement messageOnRide(String). This parameter-list mismatch means code that uses the no-arg call in the template (and described in the problem) will not compile against the solution's interfaces/implementations and will confuse students about the intended method signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the signature consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix: change the solution to declare Rideable.messageOnRide() with no parameters and update Pig and Seal to implement public String messageOnRide() returning "Riding on [Animal Type] [name]" so it matches the UML and the template Main usage. Alternatively, if the equipment parameter is intentional, update the problem statement, UML, and the template Main to document and call messageOnRide(String equipment) (and update example calls) so all artifacts use the same parameterized signature.
